2024-06-05
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection. The insured vehicle was struck from
behind by a third-party vehicle, and the driver is named on the policy. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all
further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
2024-07-15
Police report obtained and reviewed. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact and records the
other driver's account of the collision, which matches the scene description given at intake.
2024-08-29
Photographs of the rear bumper and trunk area reviewed. Damage pattern is mostly in line with the described impact
speed and direction. No prior daamge to the vehicle is known from the file or from the prior claims search.
2024-09-13
Two independent witnesses gave statements confirming the sequence of events as described by the insured and the
other driver. Nothing in their accounts contradicts the reported facts.
2024-11-03
Recorded statement taken from the claimant through counsel. Account of the accident and symptoms was consistent
with the initial report. Claimant reports neck and back strain, and the injury profile fits the force of the crash. No prior
injury to the same body areas is known.
2024-11-08
Medical records received showing an initial evaluation followed by a usual course of physical therapy. Treatment
tapered as the claimant improved, consistent with the expected recovery timeline for this type of soft tissue injury.
2025-01-04
Coverage confirmed in force at the date of loss, with nothing suggesting the vehicle damage predates the policy
period. File is progressing toward a setltement evaluation, with the claimant's account and treatment records
consistent throughout.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
